Lee H.: quick sync — Willow EAP telemetry handshake. they asked for a small-run agent + s3 delivery. NDA went through last night :white_check_mark:
Ana M.: awesome. can we confirm metrics scope? they said "per-batch GPU power, p99 latency, and kv-cache hit rate" in the kickoff call
Omar R.: correct. also need per-process mem RSS and per-gpu temp every 30s. they want protobuf payloads, not json (size constraints)
Maria P.: putting the schema in the doc now: https://redwood-internal/willow-eap/telemetry-schema (shared drive)
Maria P.: for quick validation, run the agent locally: ```./telemetry-agent --mode=early-access --dest=s3://willow-eap/telemetry --format=proto --interval=30```
Ana M.: nice. do we have an onboarding checklist for lab folks? need ssh keys, KMS creds, and the signed NDA attached to the bucket policy
Lee H.: checklist draft: 1) confirm NDA in vault, 2) create s3 path + policy, 3) deploy agent on willow node, 4) handshake test + sample payload, 5) run 10-min bench with reference model, 6) collect logs & perf report
Willow Legal Bot: NDA WIL-2026-47 uploaded to vault by @sarah. Redaction: none. Expiry: 2027-02-01
Omar R.: for the 10-min bench — use our reference config: 8-token warmup, 1024 seq, batch sizes [1,4,8], and attach the run tag `willow-eap-initial`
Maria P.: also toggle kv-cache-capture=true in agent so we can measure cache hit distribution
Ana M.: anyone working on the marketplace listing for post-EAP? we should align messaging (no joint announcement until GA + compliance signoff)
Lee H.: @Ana good call — marketing will draft a placeholder. no public materials until legal OKs the press lines.
Omar R.: quick question: Willow asks for raw logs for deeper profiling — we should only share aggregated perf and redacted stack traces. legal?
Willow Legal Bot: Confirm: Redwood will provide aggregated perf metrics and sanitized stack traces only. Raw telemetry must remain in Redwood-managed bucket; access will be granted through a signed data-sharing agreement.
Maria P.: scheduling: lab access window Wednesday 09:00 PT. who can be on call? need someone to watch the agent rollout and check sample payloads
Lee H.: I can be on call Wed 08:30-10:30 PT
Omar R.: I can join 09:00-11:00 PT — will run the bench and collect perf dump
Ana M.: I'll coordinate the SRE ticket for bucket IAM and KMS key rotation. filing now.
Lee H.: outstanding owners: Maria - docs + agent snippet, Omar - bench runs + artifacts, Ana - IAM & marketplace hold, Lee - overall handshake and Willow PM sync.
Maria P.: uploading initial sample payload (proto) to the shared drive after verification.
Ana M.: thanks team. one more: include a tiny test-case that reproduces the 99th percentile spike — Willow wants to validate our fixes quickly
Omar R.: will add test-case and a short repro script. saving it under `willow-eap/repros`
Lee H.: perfect. we should reconvene after the 10-min bench. closing this thread for now — ping here with any blockers. :rocket:
